mission.title: Implement Warm Maritime Precision Design System
mission.design_direction: Warm Maritime Precision — linen base, maritime navy, terracotta SOS, soft shadows, editorial typography. Professional, chic, enterprise-grade. Inspired by Untitled UI spacing discipline, Craft warmth, Linear typographic confidence, Stripe data hierarchy.
mission.rule: Every subagent must follow the design tokens exactly. Agents may add new components or micro-interactions if they enhance UX, but must strictly follow the color palette, typography, spacing system, shadow system, and border-radius scale defined in the DESIGN_TOKENS block below.

DESIGN_TOKENS.description: Single source of truth. All subagents read this block before writing any code.

shadows.rule: All shadows use navy tint rgba(28,58,94,...) — never pure black rgba(0,0,0,...)

display.use: Page titles, stat values, card headings, auth titles

body.use: All body text, labels, buttons, inputs, descriptions

mono.use: GPS coordinates, driver tags (e.g. carlos#4821), timestamps, latency readings, code values only

component_patterns.card: bg-surface, 1px border hairline, border-radius-lg (16px), shadow-sm. On hover: shadow-md. Padding 20px 22px.
component_patterns.card_inset: bg-base, 1px border hairline, border-radius (12px), padding 16px 18px. Used for data blocks inside cards.
component_patterns.stat_card: Same as card + 3px accent bar at top (full width, matches semantic color) + stat-icon 36x36 rounded-sm with color/14 alpha background.
component_patterns.button_primary: bg-navy, white text, shadow 0 1px 3px rgba(28,58,94,0.3) + 0 4px 12px rgba(28,58,94,0.2). Hover: bg-navy-md, stronger shadow.
component_patterns.button_ghost: bg-transparent, color ink-2, border 1px hairline. Hover: bg-base-2.
component_patterns.badge_online: bg-sage-lt, color sage, with 5x5 dot currentColor.
component_patterns.badge_sos: bg-terra-lt, color terra, with pulsing dot.
component_patterns.input_field: bg-base, 1.5px border hairline, border-radius-sm. Focus: border navy 40% opacity + box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(28,58,94,0.07). Font: Instrument Sans 14px.
component_patterns.page_eyebrow: font-mono 10px, color navy-md, letter-spacing 0.12em, uppercase, flex row with 16px wide 1.5px navy-md line before text.
component_patterns.page_title: Bricolage Grotesque 26px, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.03em, color ink.
component_patterns.section_title: Bricolage Grotesque 13px, weight 600, color ink-2, letter-spacing -0.01em.
component_patterns.avatar: Circle, bg color/18 alpha, text color full. Sizes: 44px (16px font), 38px (13px), 32px (11px), 28px (10px). Font: Bricolage Grotesque weight 700.
component_patterns.online_dot_on_avatar: 8-10px circle, bg sage-md, border 2px surface, absolute bottom-right of avatar.
component_patterns.progress_bar: 5px height, bg hairline, border-radius 3px. Fill uses semantic color. Animate width with 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) transition.
component_patterns.toast: bg-surface, 1px border hairline, border-radius 10px, shadow-sm, padding 10px 12px. Icon: 32x32 border-radius 8px with color/lt bg. Title: Instrument Sans 12px weight 600. Body: 11px muted.

animation_rules.list_items: opacity 0 + translateY 4px → opacity 1 + translateY 0, duration 0.18s, stagger 0.04s per item
animation_rules.hover_lift: translateY 0 → -1px on card hover, with shadow-sm → shadow-md transition 0.2s
animation_rules.sos_pulse: box-shadow grow 0→7px rgba(184,80,57,0.0) with 1.8s ease-in-out infinite
animation_rules.live_dot: box-shadow grow and fade on sage color, 2.4s infinite
animation_rules.ring_expand: scale 0.65→1.8, opacity 0.5→0, 2.8s ease-out infinite. Multiple rings with 0.9s delay offset.
animation_rules.waveform: Per-bar height driven by Math.abs(Math.sin(tick * 0.25 + i * 0.55)) * 26 + 12px base
animation_rules.progress_fill_entrance: Width transition 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) on component mount
animation_rules.slide_toggle: max-height + opacity transition 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) for expanding/collapsing fields
animation_rules.mobile_slide: x: -100% → 0 and x: 100% → 0, spring stiffness 260 damping 20 (Framer Motion)
animation_rules.map_pin_hover: scale 1 → 1.2, duration 0.2s on map pin hover

subagents.name: Foundation Agent
subagents.title: Global CSS Variables, Fonts, Reset, Root Layout
subagents.description: Establish the entire design token system as CSS custom properties available globally. This is the first step — all other subagents depend on these variables existing.

instructions: Remove all existing CSS variable declarations in :root
Add the Google Fonts @import as the very first line of globals.css
Declare all color, shadow, radius, and font variables from DESIGN_TOKENS.css_variables inside :root
Set body { font-family: var(--font-body); background: var(--base); color: var(--ink); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; line-height: 1.5; }
Add scrollbar styling: width 4px, track transparent, thumb var(--hairline), border-radius 4px
Add .animate-screen-in keyframe: from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px) } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) }
Add .animate-list-item keyframe: same as screen-in but 0.15s duration
Add .animate-live-pulse keyframe for sage-colored live dot
Add .animate-sos-beat keyframe: box-shadow 0→7px rgba(184,80,57,0) 1.8s infinite
Add .animate-ring-expand keyframe: scale 0.65→1.8, opacity 0.5→0, 2.8s ease-out infinite
Set --font-display, --font-body, --font-mono as CSS vars pointing to the three Google Font families
Extend theme.colors with: navy, sage, terra, honey, slate, ink, muted, subtle, hairline, base, surface — each mapped to their CSS variable using 'var(--name)'
Extend theme.fontFamily with: display, body, mono pointing to the CSS vars
Extend theme.boxShadow with: xs, sm, md, lg, nav pointing to CSS vars
Extend theme.borderRadius with: sm, DEFAULT, lg, xl, '2xl' pointing to CSS vars
This enables Tailwind classes like bg-navy, text-sage, shadow-md, rounded-lg throughout the project
Replace the Inter font import with a next/font/google import for Bricolage Grotesque (weights 400,600,700,800, subsets ['latin']) and Instrument Sans (weights 400,500,600, subsets ['latin'])
Apply both font CSS variables to the html element className
Ensure the <Providers> wrapper and <Toaster> remain untouched
Set Toaster props: richColors position='top-right', toastOptions with style using surface background, hairline border, shadow-md, Instrument Sans font

Props: icon (string emoji), label (string), value (string), delta (string), deltaType ('up'|'down'|'neutral'), accentColor (string hex).

Props: eyebrow (string), title (string), subtitle (string), actions (ReactNode optional).

Title: Bricolage Grotesque 26px weight 700, letter-spacing -0.03em, color ink.

Props: children, count (number optional).
Title: Bricolage Grotesque 13px weight 600, color ink-2, letter-spacing -0.01em.

subagents.name: Driver Pages Agent
subagents.title: Restyle all driver-facing pages: Dashboard, Map, Friends, Profile, Stress
subagents.description: Apply the design system to every page in app/(protected)/. Use PageHeader, StatCard, DriverRow, Card, Badge, and Button components from SA-02. Add Framer Motion entrance animations.

instructions: Use <PageHeader eyebrow='Driver Portal' title='Dashboard' subtitle='Broadcasting · X drivers nearby'> with refresh button + LiveConnectionBadge on right.
My Location card: <Card> with <CardInset> showing lat/lng/accuracy in three columns each with font-mono label + value. 'Broadcasting' badge-online top right. Update Location button btn-primary.
Shift status card: route, depot, ETA, status in key-value rows. ProgressBar component at bottom showing route completion.
Nearby Drivers section: <SectionTitle count={n}>. AnimatePresence grid, each DriverRow with Framer Motion stagger 0.04s.
All page content: initial opacity 0 translateY 8px, animate to visible on mount.

Emergency button card: background linear-gradient(145deg, terra-lt, surface). Button: 96px circle bg-terra, shadow 0 6px 24px rgba(184,80,57,0.4). Three concentric ring divs with animate-ring-expand, delays 0s/1.3s/2.6s.
Analytics card: Bricolage Grotesque 36px value, letter-spacing -4px. Bar chart with terra colors (current month full opacity, last 2 months 45%, rest 18%).

Active alerts list: Card with border rgba(184,80,57,0.15), gradient bg. Alert row: avatar + name + tag + location + coordinates + time. Buttons: Call (btn-soft), View Map (btn-ghost), Resolve (btn-sage).
Confirmation dialog: AnimatePresence modal, scale 0.95→1 + opacity, spring animation.
Search/tag input: field-input style with UserPlus icon button btn-primary on right.
Incoming requests: AnimatePresence list, each item Card with accept (btn-sage btn-icon) + decline (btn-ghost btn-icon), sender name + tag + relative time.

Friends list: each friend as Card hover-lift with avatar (color/18 bg), name (Bricolage Grotesque 14px), tag (font-mono 11px muted), three action buttons — Message (btn-soft), Map (btn-ghost), Call (btn-soft with phone icon).
Location expand: AnimatePresence height animation, shows lat/lng in font-mono inside card-inset, plus 'View on Map' link.
Avatar section: 96x96 circle with color/18 bg or image, change photo on hover (overlay with camera icon bg-navy/70). Upload button btn-soft.
Info card: tag displayed as badge-navy font-mono. Name, email, created-at in key-value rows. Edit name: field-input inline, save btn-primary btn-sm.
Page entrance: motion.div opacity 0 y 12 → visible 0.3s.
Floating overlays use glass background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9) backdrop-blur border hairline border-radius-lg shadow-md.
Current user pin: blue navy color 14px dot, border 3px white, shadow 0 2px 8px rgba(28,58,94,0.3). Three concentric ring-expand animations.
Driver pins: 12px dots with semantic color, border 2.5px white.
Pin labels: Instrument Sans 9px weight 600, bg rgba(255,255,255,0.92) padding 2px 6px border-radius 4px border hairline shadow-xs.
Selected driver popup: bg surface/97, border hairline, border-radius-lg, shadow-lg, padding 16px 18px. Animation screen-in 0.2s.
Driver list panel: scroll-y with card-inset rows.

Card: bg-surface border hairline border-radius-2xl (24px) shadow-lg padding 36px, max-width 420px, width full.
Top: 🚛 emoji 36px + 'TruckNet' font-mono 11px text-navy letter-spacing 0.12em uppercase. Centered.
Title: 'Welcome back' Bricolage Grotesque 22px weight 700 letter-spacing -0.03em.
Subtitle: 'Sign in to your TruckNet account' 13px muted.
Inputs: Email and Password using field-input pattern from SA-02.
Submit: btn-primary full-width padding 11px 20px font-size 14px label 'Sign In →'.
Footer note: centered 13px subtle 'Admins are automatically redirected to Fleet Dashboard'.
Divider + 'Create new account' btn-ghost full-width below.
Form validation errors: bg-terra-lt border rgba(184,80,57,0.2) border-radius (12px) padding 10px 14px text-terra fs-13 margin-bottom 16px.
Title: 'Join TruckNet'. Subtitle: 'Choose your account type to get started'.

Role selector: 2-column grid. Each card: padding 16px, border-radius (12px), border 1.5px hairline, bg-base, cursor pointer. Hover: border rgba(28,58,94,0.25) bg-navy-pale. Selected: border-navy-md bg-navy-lt box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(28,58,94,0.08). Icon 26px emoji. Label Instrument Sans 13px fw-600. Desc 11px muted. Transition all 0.2s.
Fields: Full Name, Email, Password using field-input pattern.

Admin Invite Code field: only visible when 'Fleet Admin' is selected. Animate via max-height + opacity slide: max-height 0→90px, opacity 0→1, duration 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1). Field border-color rgba(201,138,46,0.3) bg-honey-lt. Helper text below: 11px honey '🔒 Required to register as Fleet Admin'.
Submit: btn-primary full-width label dynamically 'Create Driver Account →' or 'Create Admin Account →'.
Error handling: same terra error box as login.

cross_cutting_rules.title: Rules every subagent must follow without exception
rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, system-ui, or any font other than Bricolage Grotesque (display), Instrument Sans (body), JetBrains Mono (data/mono). These three fonts are non-negotiable.
NEVER use pure black shadows rgba(0,0,0,...). All shadows must use rgba(28,58,94,...) — the navy tint.
NEVER use a dark background on any page or component. The entire app uses the warm linen palette. The previous dark theme is completely replaced.
NEVER use purple, violet, or generic blue (#3B82F6) as accent colors. Use only the defined palette: navy, sage, terra, honey, slate.
ALL border-radius values must come from the scale: 8px, 12px, 16px, 20px, 24px. Never use odd values like 6px or 10px.
ALL spacing must follow the 8px grid: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48px. No 15px, 10px, 25px, etc.
Framer Motion is already installed. Use it for: page entrances, list item staggering, modal scales, sidebar slides, active indicator transitions (layoutId).
Sonner toasts must use the new design: surface bg, hairline border, navy-tinted shadow, Instrument Sans font, semantic icon colors.
Every destructive action (SOS resolve, decline call, reject friend) must use terra color. Every success/confirmation uses sage.
GPS coordinates, driver tags, timestamps, call duration, and latency values always use JetBrains Mono. Never Instrument Sans for these.

Agents may add new polish such as: skeleton loading states, empty state illustrations, hover tooltips, micro-animations on click — as long as they follow the design tokens and do not change functionality.

agent_may_add.description: The agent is encouraged to add these enhancements if they fit naturally and follow the design system
suggestions: Skeleton loading states for every table and list — use animate-pulse bg-base-2 rounded shapes
Empty state components with emoji illustration + title + subtitle for: no nearby drivers, no messages, no SOS alerts, no call history
Hover tooltips on icon-only buttons (position absolute, bg-ink rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-white fs-11)
Smooth number count-up animation on StatCard values using a simple useEffect counter
Subtle noise texture overlay on the linen background: a 0.03 opacity SVG noise filter on the body adds depth
Focus-visible ring: 3px solid rgba(28,58,94,0.5) offset 2px on all interactive elements for accessibility
Page transition: AnimatePresence on the route group layout for cross-page transitions
Pull-to-refresh gesture indicator on mobile map and dashboard
